notes.title: Character selection redesign, new ascension level, and balance change.
notes.content:
Balance change:

+ Magic sword buff: Mana-scale increase from 100% to 200%. This means that the power of this spell (damage dealt) increase by 2 for every 1 mana cost.
+ Magic-healing sword buff: Mana scale increase from 66% to 200%. This means that this sword will attack and HEAL for a lot more damage and healing now.
+ Magic axe buff: Mana-scale increase from 75% to 150%.  This means that the power of this spell (damage dealt) increase by 1.5 for every 1 mana cost.

+ Ascension 1 (HELL), heal to full at the end of the stage. Increase from 50%.
+ Add new ascension mode: EARTH - This will take place of the PURGATORY Ascension (3rd ascension). 
+ Purgatory ascension now effect as below:
1. Max HP is 70 (Reduce from 125 from Ascension 1)
2. Enemy will start at 100% hp instead of damaged
3. Will not heal after stage ends. Must seek the Vitality rewards or spells or relics to heal.
4. Still have strong starting decks.
5. Reward cards reward is still strong

+ Reward Vitality, the healing and maxHP reward spell will automatically added to the existing cards if exist on hand. This make sure that your playing hand is not super cluttered and overall clear the hand vision a bit. Hand stacking feature (stacking cards of the same type and upgrade) will come in a future update.

Basically, this new ascension remove point 1, 2 and 3 from the HELL difficulty. This is to make the jumping of ascension easier and does not cause a sudden spike of difficulty when jumping from HELL to the old PURGATORY.

Remove these 9 language:
+ Italian
+ Czech
+ Finnish
+ Indonesian
+ Polish
+ Swedish
+ Thai
+ Turkish
+ Ukrainian

No one is playing them, and whenever I updated the game, having to update more localization rows are just too much work for me for now. When the demo and the main game is all done and done, I will consider updating them once and for all and re-update them into the game.

Bug-fix:

+ Fix a bug that cause Relic Over-heal (increase MaxHP when overheal) to not work when player is heal with GOLD.

notes.title: Layout redesign. It looks so pretty!
notes.content:
The old design looks alright. I just slowly build it up from the scratch, drawing various inspiration from slot-machine game, as well as many popular deck-builder games.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040259/8880156fe106c908f0c966a0e2fa640518f6191c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040259/8880156fe106c908f0c966a0e2fa640518f6191c.gif[/img][/url]

This looks fine on its own, however, there are few problem with this.

1. Size of the buttons are just too big, which I heard many people say that it has this mobile vibe.

2. While the slot-machine is right in the middle, which is quite standard for slot-game, I don't think it's really helpful in this game, since the slot, while important, only is a part of the game. Most important is how you use your cards and utilize your shops, and how to save your cards.

3. Because the shop is its own separate tabs from the slot-machine, it's quite unclear for first time-player how the shop is related to the reel, as well as which shop position goes to which reel.

This re-design attempted to fix this problem, first by created a grouping between the player's team, and the enemies. Also, by moving the reel to the left and merge it with the shop, it makes the shop intention quite clear (I think) and also leave a lot more space for the beautiful landscape and the battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040259/990e3ccfce7e0c3b3a70216f2a4b9bd0a29ca0f1.png[/img]

notes.title: Ascension 0 mode added. Reduce first timer difficulty by half
notes.content:
Hi all,

After having the DEMO out for 10 days now, and seeing so many player struggle with the game, and quit early, I decided that changes are needed to help new players easing into the game a lot easier. 

Hopefully these changes will improve this awesome DEMO median play-time too. It was 3 minutes after a few days of release. After the releasing of the tutorial, it's 7 minutes now, which I say the tutorial from the last patch has done it job nicely, but still, I spend a lot of time thinking about the final boss, and the bonus stage, and less than 10% of the players have seen it, so I just want more people to know about it and experience the awesomeness of the final boss.

Anyway, here is the detailed changes:

1. Player's MaxHP increase from 70 -> 125
2. Player will automatically heals 50% of max HP when entering the next stage. The original difficulty does not have any healing at all, because I want to encourages more careful play and remove stalling, but it's too hard as off now, and that feeling when you enter the next stage with 5 HP, only to be defeated right on the first turn isn't fun at all. Let's have these experience when you know more about the game.
3. Enemy now starts with 75% of their Max HP only. This make it easier to kill them, but make 1 POWER (double damage for full-HP enemy useless for now).
4. The starting decks is a lot less crap now. In the original difficulty, it has 6 level 1 cards (sword, axe, staff x2 and gold x2), now, it only have 3 cards, 1 sword, 1 staff, and 1 gold. This makes the cost of cleaning the decks a lot cheaper, and buying new cards into your deck will have a lot effect as their chance of appearing is significantly higher.
5. As a result, the starting cards that you select will have its level increased as well. Originally, the choices are 1 level 2 card, and 2 level 1 cards, with random chance of each card is DEMON or DOOM upgraded. Now, You can have a level 3-3-2 combo, 4-2-2 combo, 5-2-1 combo, or in very rare case, 6-1-1 combo.
6. Due to the changes above, End-of-stage cards rewards are also a lot stronger.

For now, the original difficulties are not found in the game. However, I will quickly create another update to add ascension mode, so that once you defeat the RnGesus in the Ascension 0, you can enjoy the DEMO in its original difficulty as well.

That's all, cheers and thanks for playing.
